commits.summary: Record the matched Java semantics decisions
commits.body:
Seven previously open historical claims now close at their frozen scope, bringing the thirteen JBMC-only leads from 6 to 13 decisions and preserving all 24 native controls. The 60 separately registered caller statements went from 12 to 50 decisions across 13 improved families, with 29 proofs and 21 original-JVM-replayed refutations. Both previously JVM-contradicted default-method results were corrected. The full Commons Lang intervals and both Guava builds met the stretch criteria.

Link the per-claim results and first unproved operations for all 16 examples, the ordinary decimal and formatter transfers, and the separate standalone model disagreements. The evidence audit checked 283 loaded class bindings across 21 original classpaths, both actual array witnesses, eight default-method witnesses and the original worker schedules. All 16 examples validated, 59 Rust test binaries and 29 Python test files passed, and the source-bound scorecard reproduced all 38 historical rows and 60 caller rows. Both managed proof-tier conformance tests passed. Of 32 campaign jobs, 31 passed and one intermediate Unicode witness launcher failed to compile before its passing replacement.
